caption: C's no vote decides the run: the coordinator sends abort to all three sites, all roll back and ack, and 3 prepare + 3 votes + 3 abort + 3 ack = 12 messages leave net movement at ₹0. Only a COMMIT needs a forced log record; an abort record is optional.

spec.aria: A two-phase commit sequence for a ₹5,000 transfer: the coordinator sends prepare to sites A, B and C; A and B vote yes while C votes no because its audit row is locked; the coordinator sends abort to all three; each site releases locks and acknowledges, making 12 messages and net movement ₹0.
